heading: New things to make, and steadier jobs
body: Simple mode has new choices: Spreadsheet, Document, Slides, App or script, and List or data. Each one saves a real file. Meldmind now makes real PowerPoint decks, one slide per heading, with speaker notes. A plain chat answer that names a file now saves it too, on every plan, and says where it went. When an AI runs out of its usage allowance, its step goes to the next AI instead of stopping the job, and a stuck plan no longer waits forever. After Update and restart, the new version starts on its own. Expert's Command page scrolls on wide screens, and the chat box no longer covers an answer's buttons.
